newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria issues 10-yr 15 bln ATS 5.625 pct bond.
newsitem.headline: Austria issues 10-yr 15 bln ATS 5.625 pct bond.

text.p: Austria on Tuesday issued a 10-year 15 billion schilling bond with a coupon of 5.625 percent and a maximum yield of 5.9 percent, the Austrian Kontrollbank said.
It said 37.47 percent of bids were covered with an average yield of 5.67852 percent and an issue price of 99.60 percent.
Start date for the new bond is January 17. Austria last issued a bond on October 22. That bond, with a 5.875 percent coupon, matures on July 15, 2006. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
